result:
The form manager now keeps generated identifiers because a retried save used to request a new identifier from the source each time. Commit `b4b76423` (PR #2780, ticket O3-5916) fixed this. The registration form lives in `openmrs-esm-patient-management` under `packages/esm-patient-registration-app`; there is no separate `openmrs-esm-patient-registration-app` repository in Falkon.

**What changed and why**

- **Generated values are reused.** Before the fix, `savePatient` called `generateIdentifier(selectedSource.uuid)` on every attempt. A retry after a failed save therefore consumed another identifier from the source and sent a different value. The fix stores each generated value on a `SavePatientTransactionManager`, keyed by field name and source UUID, and reuses it when the source matches. A new value is generated only when the source changed. (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/form-manager.ts:217-235`, `.../form-manager.ts:425-440`)
- **Completed additions are not repeated.** For an existing patient, the identifier-addition step ran again on retry, so an identifier that had already been added could be added twice. The fix records each successful addition in `addedIdentifiers` and skips it on a later attempt. (`.../form-manager.ts:250-256`)
- **Tests cover the cases.** The new tests check that a retried new-patient save reuses `10001V`, that a successful addition is not repeated after a later save failure, that a failed addition is retried with the same value, and that a changed source generates a new value. (`.../form-manager.test.ts:724-787`, `.../patient-registration.test.tsx:697`)

**Commit and ticket:** `b4b76423` is "(fix) O3-5916: Reuse generated identifiers when retrying a patient save (#2780)". I read the diff of `form-manager.ts` for that commit, and it contains the generation-reuse and addition-skip logic described above. The commit message names ticket O3-5916 and PR #2780.
